findings.description: Ling Nam, a Filipino-Chinese bakery operating in the Bay Area since 1990, plans its first San Francisco bakeshop at 3349 Mission Street in Bernal Heights, in the space formerly occupied by Golden State Pizza & Grill, targeting a late-2026 opening. The Chronicle attributes the address to a KRON4 interview and adds its own earlier reporting on the business; KRON4 is not a registered feed, so the Chronicle is cited. The owner is not recorded here.
